purpose: Current online/competitor research plus sealed-product/GitHub/live-state triangulation for the attorney-value-clarity release.

competitorEvidence.observed: Explains lead management through visible pipeline outcomes, intake forms, follow-up, appointments and source/channel tracking.

buildDecisions.item: Rewrite attorney demo surfaces in simple benefit-first language while preserving truth labels.
Replace internal terms such as suppression, native/external-primary and purpose-limited access on attorney-visible tour surfaces.
Keep compliance explanation concrete: mapped rules, reasons, sources and human review when uncertain.
One-platform legal-area model; no return to public micro-portal navigation.
Owner deployment hold and last accepted-live pre49 rollback authority.
Competitor trade-dress copying, guaranteed-growth claims or presentation of gated features as live.
